subject: POC environment prerequisites & owners — MAP draft
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@stellardata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC environment prerequisites & owners — MAP draft

Alex — thanks for the time earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone list for the POC environment so we can lock owners and target dates. I attached a one-page draft MAP (MAP_draft_v1.pdf). Please review and confirm owners / timing below.

High-level goals
- Target POC start: 2026-10-04
- Run depth: 2 weeks of curated load tests + evals
- Target decision: 2026-10-25

POC environment prerequisites (proposed owners & dependencies)
1) VPC peering / routing
   - Owner (customer): Stellar Data infra (Alex / Mark)
   - Action items: open peering ticket with cloud provider; share peering CIDR + expected egress ranges
   - Dependency: peering approved by 2026-09-28 to meet start date

2) IP allowlists / NAT egress
   - Owner (customer): Network team (Mark Tran) to provide static egress IPs or proxy config
   - Action items: provide allowlist entries to Redwood (we will provide test endpoints)

3) SSO / SAML configuration
   - Owner (customer): Security (Priya Sharma)
   - Action items: share SAML metadata and accepted entityID; confirm attribute mappings (email, name, groups)
   - Note: Redwood will provide SP metadata and a test IdP sandbox if needed

4) Secrets / KMS access model
   - Owner (customer): Cloud security / ops (Priya / Mark)
   - Action items: provide KMS key ARN and desired rotation policy; agree on whether Redwood will bring customer-managed key or use customer-side envelope encryption

5) Test data / sample traffic & success criteria
   - Owner (customer + Redwood)
   - Action items: customer to provide 2 representative prompt sets and the Redwood team to prepare evaluation harness

Next steps (please confirm by EOD next Tuesday)
- Confirm owners above and any date blockers
- If OK, we’ll schedule a technical deep-dive (network + SSO) for the week of 2026-09-20
- We’ll update the MAP doc and push to HubSpot (link below)

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (one-page)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-1189

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we confirm availability.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Li <alex.li@stellardata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Tran <mark.tran@stellardata.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@stellardata.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T18:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC environment prerequisites & owners — MAP draft

Thanks Ben — good summary. I’ve run this by Mark (network) and Priya (security); a few clarifications from our side: 

- VPC peering: we can do peering but we need to raise a ticket with our cloud provider (typical SLA ~7 business days). I can start that after we lock the CIDRs. Mark will own this.
- IP allowlist: we generally prefer to supply a /29 or the proxy IPs rather than opening broad ranges. Mark will confirm exact egress IPs by 2026-09-20.
- SSO / SAML: Priya will provide SAML metadata but we require Redwood to accept the following attribute mapping: email -> http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress and groups -> custom:groups. Also need Redwood SP entityID and ACS URL.
- KMS: we use an AWS CMK under account 123456789012. We generally do not export key material; we can provide a policy that allows Redwood to use the key via assumed role (will share a draft).

We’re happy to join the tech deep-dive — availability next week looks best on Tue/Wed after 14:00 PT. Also, can you confirm who from Redwood will own the SSO setup from your side (to make it single-threaded)?

I’ll share Mark and Priya’s calendars separately and attach the initial security checklist we typically use.

Cheers,
Alex Li
Head of Product & Partnerships | Stellar Data
alex.li@stellardata.com
(650) 555-0110
